```{=html}
<style>
.quantum-chameleon-stage {
  position: relative;
  width: min(980px, 100%);
  aspect-ratio: 1200 / 620;
  margin: 0.18rem auto 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
  border-radius: 18px;
  background: #76cbea;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 46px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.34);
  cursor: pointer;
  user-select: none;
  -webkit-user-select: none;
}

.quantum-chameleon-stage:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid #ffe08a;
  outline-offset: 4px;
}

.quantum-chameleon-stage svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.qc-branch-shadow {
  fill: rgba(23, 28, 22, 0.16);
  filter: blur(5px);
}

.qc-chameleon-outline {
  fill: none;
  stroke: #203a35;
  stroke-width: 3.5;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
  vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
}

.qc-chameleon-outline.is-far-leg {
  stroke-width: 2.8;
  opacity: 0.46;
}

.qc-chameleon-underlay {
  fill: none;
  stroke: #203a35;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
  vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
}

.qc-chameleon-detail {
  fill: none;
  stroke: rgba(24, 54, 47, 0.82);
  stroke-width: 2.3;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
}

.qc-chameleon-scale {
  fill: rgba(241, 255, 213, 0.34);
  stroke: rgba(30, 67, 57, 0.42);
  stroke-width: 1.2;
  vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
}

.qc-eye-turret {
  fill: rgba(202, 232, 142, 0.42);
  stroke: #263d38;
  stroke-width: 2.6;
  vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
}

.qc-eye-white {
  fill: rgba(243, 246, 212, 0.96);
  stroke: #263d38;
  stroke-width: 2.7;
  vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
}

.qc-eye-iris {
  fill: #ffd449;
  stroke: #263d38;
  stroke-width: 2.2;
  vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
}

.qc-eye-pupil {
  fill: #172926;
}

.qc-nostril {
  fill: #243b35;
  opacity: 0.88;
}

.qc-tongue-line {
  fill: none;
  stroke: #ef4763;
  stroke-width: 7;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
  vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
}

.qc-tongue-highlight {
  fill: none;
  stroke: rgba(255, 183, 190, 0.82);
  stroke-width: 1.7;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
}

.qc-tongue-tip {
  fill: #f25a70;
  stroke: #8f2d45;
  stroke-width: 1.8;
  vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
}

.qc-butterfly-wing {
  fill: #ffd65c;
  stroke: #705036;
  stroke-width: 1.4;
  vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
}

.qc-butterfly-body {
  fill: #705036;
}

.qc-replay-hint {
  position: absolute;
  right: 18px;
  bottom: 14px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  padding: 6px 10px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.52);
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
  background: rgba(17, 50, 54, 0.32);
  font: 600 14px/1 system-ui, sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transform: translateY(4px);
  transition: opacity 280ms ease, transform 280ms ease;
  backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
}

.qc-metaphor-note {
  position: absolute;
  left: 18px;
  bottom: 14px;
  max-width: 780px;
  padding: 7px 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.48);
  border-radius: 12px;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
  background: rgba(17, 50, 54, 0.68);
  font: 600 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  pointer-events: none;
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
}

.qc-metaphor-note strong {
  color: #ffe08a;
}

.quantum-chameleon-stage:hover .qc-replay-hint,
.quantum-chameleon-stage:focus-visible .qc-replay-hint {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateY(0);
}

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .quantum-chameleon-stage {
    border-radius: 12px;
  }

  .qc-replay-hint {
    right: 10px;
    bottom: 9px;
    font-size: 11px;
  }

  .qc-metaphor-note {
    left: 10px;
    bottom: 9px;
    max-width: calc(100% - 150px);
    padding: 5px 8px;
    font-size: 10px;
  }
}
</style>
```
